participant_id.Description: Participant specific identification number (sub, sub_id) in BIDS format, e.g.: sub-0001

id.Description: numeric variant of the participant specific identification number

task.Description: string that indicates the task the individual trial belongs to

cohort.LongName: which vmp cohort does the data belong to
cohort.Description: Indicates whether the data in the current row was acquired during vmp1 or vmp 2

idx.Description: Numeric identifier used in the Stan models(1 through 513)

mean_RT.Description: Response time (mean) for the firt level decision

sd_RT.Description: Response time (standard deviation) for the firt level decision

Accuracy.Description: Procentage of correct responses (response = faster when Alpha > 0 or response = slower when Alpha < 0). If Alpha == 0, Accuracy was coded as 0

estimated_mean_beta.Description: Estimated mean of the slope for the particular subject. These are the standard deviations of the cummulative normal.

estimated_mean_alpha.Description: Estimated mean of the threshold for the particular subject.

estimated_mean_lapse.LongName: Estimated mean of the lapse rate
estimated_mean_lapse.Description: Estimated mean of the lapse rate for the particular subject. These control the tails of the psychometric function and were it asympotes to when Alpha -> -Inf & Inf

estimated_q5_beta.LongName: Estimated 5% percentile of the posteror distribution of the slope
estimated_q5_beta.Description: Estimated 5% percentile of the posteror distribution of the slope for the particular subject. These are the standard deviations of the cummulative normal.

estimated_q5_alpha.LongName: Estimated 5% percentile of the posteror distribution of the threshold
estimated_q5_alpha.Description: Estimated 5% percentile of the posteror distribution of the threshold for the particular subject.

estimated_q5_lapse.LongName: Estimated 5% percentile of the posteror distribution of the lapse rate
estimated_q5_lapse.Description: Estimated 5% percentile of the posteror distribution of the lapse rate for the particular subject. These control the tails of the psychometric function and were it asympotes to when Alpha -> -Inf & Inf

estimated_q95_beta.LongName: Estimated 95% percentile of the posteror distribution of the slope
estimated_q95_beta.Description: Estimated 95% percentile of the posteror distribution of the slope for the particular subject. These are the standard deviations of the cummulative normal.

estimated_q95_alpha.LongName: Estimated 95% percentile of the posteror distribution of the threshold
estimated_q95_alpha.Description: Estimated 95% percentile of the posteror distribution of the threshold for the particular subject.

estimated_q95_lapse.LongName: Estimated 95% percentile of the posteror distribution of the lapse rate
estimated_q95_lapse.Description: Estimated 95% percentile of the posteror distribution of the lapse rate for the particular subject. These control the tails of the psychometric function and were it asympotes to when Alpha -> -Inf & Inf
